title: Culture, Economics and Politics of Europe
description: Examines the cultural, social, economic and political history of post-WWII Europe from an interdisciplinary perspective. Introduces key issues associated with the study of decolonization, European integration, migration and other important aspects that shaped the societies and cultures of modern Europe. Discusses the role of the European Union in Europe and the world.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EUS 270, EUS 100, ECON 270, SLLC 270
